hint.1: Welcome! Double jump with SPACE / A; touch the flags to save your progress.
hint.2: Moving islands carry you. Watch their rhythm before you leap.
hint.3: Dash into crates on the side islands; some contain a heart.
hint.4: Land in the middle of the pink springs to reach the higher islands.
hint.5: Conveyors can push you sideways. Orbit the camera with Q / E.
hint.6: Stopping takes time on ice. Slow down near the edges.
hint.7: Cracked islands crumble quickly. Keep moving and double jump onward.
hint.8: The wind changes direction. Dash to correct your course in the air.
hint.9: The final path above the embers! Climb using springs and moving islands.
hint.10: The guardian is waiting. Touch the last flag, jump over the waves, and wait for its weak moment.
